theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (V : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn V n) (τ : Fin n → Euclid P), IsOpen V → Orthonormal ℝ τ → IsIntegerMultiplicity S → S.support ⊆ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P)) → ∃ g : Euclid P → ℝ, AEStronglyMeasurable g (μHE[n].restrict (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P))) ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P))), ∃ m : ℤ, g x = m) ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ V → ∫⁻ x in K ∩ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P)), ‖g x‖ₑ ∂μHE[n] ≠ ∞) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn V n, S ω = ∫ x in V ∩ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P)), g x * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x τ ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → W ⊆ V → S.massOn W = ∫⁻ x in W ∩ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P)), ‖g x‖ₑ ∂μHE[n]
